description:
Activate Ravenous Baloth by sacrificing itself.
When Ravenous Baloth dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ravenous Baloth on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Ravenous Baloth ability, causing you to gain 4 life.
Cast Ravenous Baloth from the top of your library by paying 4 life.
Repeat.
